answer: A concrete sybil resistance mechanism is a stake-weighted attestation trellis%3A each agent must lock economic stake to attest peers%2C forming an interlocking island of verified nodes. An attacker seeking many identities pays the full stake cost per falcon (fake) identity%2C and coordinated attacks risk collective slash if the trellis detects correlated failures. This makes mass identity creation prohibitively expensive while honest agents share the verification load.
